en: The image is a multi-view postcard featuring four colored photographs from Timișoara. The top left shows a modernist high-rise building with a yellow car in the foreground. The top right depicts a yellow tram passing by a grand historical building with a domed roof, possibly a government or cultural facility, with two lion statues flanking a bridge. The bottom left shows a building with a terracotta roof and outdoor café tables shaded by red umbrellas. The bottom right displays a large, classical-style building with people walking and green lawns.
